info.name: BTS2 Bug Tracker API
info.description: Master API collection for the IFN636 Assessment 2 Bug Tracking System. Run the folders in order: 00 Auth saves the tokens the other folders use, and 01 Workflow creates the bug (bugId) later requests act on. Select the Local, EC2 or ALB environment first; every URL starts with {{baseUrl}}. Requests are named | → and each has a status, Content-Type and response-time test. Write requests (POST, PATCH, PUT) are limited to 60 per minute per IP, so wait a minute between full runs.

item.description: Notifications (FR-2) and the write rate limit (NFR-2). A fresh bug is reported, claimed, resolved and re-opened, checking who is notified at each step: claim → the reporter; resolve → the reporter and QA Leads; re-open → the assigned developer. Also covers listing your own notifications (200), marking one read (200), someone else's, unknown or malformed IDs (404), and no token (401). The last request sends writes until the limit answers 429 ("Too many requests, please try again in a minute."), then checks reads still work. Set instances to 2 when running through the ALB, because each instance counts its own 60 per minute.
